extras: Desktop-only plugin; preview currently validated on Windows; requires Obsidian desktop 1.12.7 or newer.
intentEvidence: Local Book Reader is a desktop-only Obsidian plugin for reading and organizing personal ebooks in the active Vault.
problem: Users need a way to read and annotate local ebook files directly inside Obsidian while maintaining privacy and keeping data local.
summary: Local Book Reader is a desktop-only plugin that allows users to read and organize personal ebooks within the active Obsidian vault while keeping all data local.
